verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo, quote mark and quote on one left edge and keeps the can sitting on the backdrop circle as in the original. Its flaws: the quote is set small for a story format, the attribution sits too close under it, and there is a dead gap between the text block and the can. B centres the logo above left-aligned text, so the elements don't share an axis. Its can only just touches the top edge of the circle, an awkward near-miss that breaks the original's layering, and the bottom third is an empty circle with nothing on it, which leaves the layout bottom-heavy and unbalanced.
